Review code changes on the erun platform

Usage:
  erun review [command]

Available Commands:
  close        Close a review without merging it
  comment      Comment on a line of a review, or reply to an existing comment
  create       Open a review on the erun platform
  list         List reviews on the erun platform
  queue        Inspect and advance a target branch's merge queue
  record-build Record a build against a review, moving it to READY or FAILED
  resolve      Resolve a comment thread by closing its root comment
  reviewers    Assign and remove reviewers on a review
  show         Show a review, its comment threads, and its recorded builds
  unresolve    Reopen a comment thread by marking its root comment OPEN

Flags:
      --erun-alias string   erun platform cloud alias to target (defaults to the sole configured erun-type alias)
  -h, --help                help for review

Global Flags:
      --output string   Result format: text (default, human stream) or json (structured result on stdout for orchestrators). (default "text")
      --time            Print the elapsed runtime after the command finishes.
  -v, --verbose count   Increase verbosity: -v streams external tool output, -vv adds erun command traces.

Use "erun review [command] --help" for more information about a command.
